chunks: And Mehrān ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:

“Indeed, when the deceased dies, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends an angel to the member of his family most pained by him, and he wipes over his heart, causing him to forget the burning anguish of grief. Were it not for that, the world would not be inhabited.”

key_terms.قَلْبِهِ: his heart, the locus of grief

ai.seo_question: How does Allah ease the grief of the family of a deceased person according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a mercy from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, shown to the bereaved after death. It teaches that the intensity of grief is divinely eased so that human life and the world’s continuation remain possible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.522 - it was narrated from Mehran ibn Muhammad that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"When a person dies, Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious, sends an angel to the one among their family who is most deeply affected by the loss. The angel touches their heart and alleviates the intensity of grief. If it were not for this, the world would not be able to continue”.
